mapper.select: /* getTargetOgdpWorkerList - Taesoo Song */ SELECT C.GROUP_AUTHRT_SE_CD AS GROUP_AUTHRT_SE_CD , (SELECT D.CMMNS_CD_VALUE_NM FROM SAC100 D WHERE D.CMMNS_CD_ID = 'GROUP_AUTHRT_SE_CD' AND D.CMMNS_CD_VALUE = C.GROUP_AUTHRT_SE_CD) AS GROUP_AUTHRT_NM , B.ENFSN_NO AS PIC_NO , A.FLNM_ENCPT AS FLNM_ENCPT , (SELECT PIC_ENFSN_NO FROM SAA000 WHERE INST_NO = #{INST_NO}) AS OGDP_PIC_NO , (SELECT PIC_NM_ENCPT FROM SAA000 WHERE INST_NO = #{INST_NO}) AS OGDP_PIC_NM , B.USER_ID AS USER_ID FROM SCA100 A JOIN SAA200 B ON A.ENFSN_NO = B.ENFSN_NO JOIN SAB230 C ON B.USER_ID = C.USER_ID WHERE C.INST_NO = #{INST_NO} AND A.DEL_YN = 'N' AND A.RETIRE_YMD IS NULL ORDER BY C.GROUP_AUTHRT_SE_CD ASC

/* getInstOgdpWorkerInfo - Taesoo Song */ SELECT A.ENFSN_NO AS ENFSN_NO , A.FLNM_ENCPT AS FLNM_ENCPT , D.GROUP_AUTHRT_SE_CD AS GROUP_AUTHRT_SE_CD , B.USER_ID AS USER_ID FROM SCA100 A JOIN SAA200 B ON A.ENFSN_NO = B.ENFSN_NO JOIN SAA000 C ON A.OGDP_INST_NO = C.INST_NO JOIN SAB230 D ON B.USER_ID = D.USER_ID WHERE A.DEL_YN = 'N' AND A.RETIRE_YMD IS NULL AND A.ENFSN_NO = #{OGDP_ENFSN_NO} AND D.INST_NO = #{INST_NO}
